about: The game's own location numbers (Game.log: <Update Inventory Location> ... Location [a] -> [b]) and the place each one is. A number is the same place on every shard and in LIVE and PTU. Taken from real sessions, Nov 2026: each entry was named by the log itself, by the landing area's name, by a route's start location or by the landing that followed seconds later. Pyro's open space (3184339241) is the one read from the pattern alone: it is the number held while flying to a gateway, as 1902223495 is in Stanton and 2627827560 in Nyx. 'near' marks the space around a station (not inside its landing area). The client adds what it learns to locations.json in its data folder.
